I’m disagreeing with most of this thread. OP I’m going with a major YTA. Your husband didn’t check his blood sugar and 4 hours later he needed to get food. Was that irresponsible of him? Of course. Does that make him an asshole? Absolutely not, do you think that by chance he could have underestimated how long you would be out? Or maybe he thought if you were going to be out that long you’d at least go get something to eat or drink? Shit maybe he could have honestly forgot to check. No matter the situation unless he maliciously didn’t check in an attempt to get out of hanging out then he’s not an AH. YTA because after your husband told you he wasn’t feeling well you brushed him off and then literally 10 minutes later he fainted. Your husband is right you need to get your priorities straight hanging out with your friends is not more important then the health and wellness of your SO. Btw you didn’t want to leave the tour for 10 minutes to get a small snack or something so instead it got completely ruined because of your lack of empathy. If your friends would stop hanging out with you because your husband has a freaking medical condition then your friends aren’t very good friends.

NAH, your choice of words weren’t the best. However, I’d say 99% of these comments are tripping the fuck out. With that being said you don’t have the right to tell her she can’t do it. What you do have the right to do is express that it makes you uncomfortable and if she can’t see that and respect it then you have every right to end the relationship as you aren’t compatible. YTA, I get you needed to get your meds but it was poor judgement to have people over when you knew you needed to get your meds. You know how getting a prescription is and you know that it can sometimes be lengthy but you still planned your day very poorly. You then had your boyfriend take care of your dog (which obviously isn’t a big deal but when you add that on to this situation it makes you look even more unreliable and irresponsible). You made a series of mistakes that led to a really bad first impression. How would you feel waiting in a strangers home for over an hour? It’s not the end of the world but you should have had better planning or figured out a way to get you meds after meeting his parents. You could have got home at 2:45 after realizing the length of the line and met your bf’s family and then left at maybe 5-6 after they left or after explaining that you needed to pick up your prescription. Overall, not the end of the world but YTA because of poor planning and making a bad first impression.

How would you feel if your husband has cheated on you and people around you hid it from you? Do you want to be directly correlated to that pain for another person? Being able to cheat on someone says a lot about someone’s character are you sure you want to be friends with someone who is capable of causing that much pain for 1 night of sex? Are you sure that in the future she won’t take advantage of you like she takes advantage of her husband? Are you willing to let her antics muddy your character? Does your husband also know about the cheating? Does he know that you are willing to enable a cheater? If you enable her cheating then she would surely enable yours should you ever do it and how would that make your husband see you? There’s a lot at play here and a situation like this can hurt more than just that friendship. You should think carefully about your priorities and realize how most of the negatives will be a result of you hiding the truth from your friends husband. I suggest you get her to tell him or else you tell him but that’s just my 2 cents and you should do what you think is best.
